what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 281 refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Sudan, 0.0% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1964 to 2025, with M23 among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1967 at 4400 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 20980, at the end of 2010; the main years of displacement in the data are 2009 and 2010.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sudan.
These are year-end totals for Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
